title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
begins: A dedication to Robinson precedes Chapter 1. Holmes sits at breakfast while Watson examines a stick left by a visitor. Holmes deduces from the engraving, "To James Mortimer, M.R.C.S.", that he is a country doctor, and Dr. Mortimer returns.
happens: Dr. Mortimer tells Holmes of a family curse: a spectral hound haunts the Baskervilles, and Sir Charles Baskerville has died on the moor. Sir Henry, the heir, comes from Canada. Holmes sends Watson with him to Baskerville Hall on Dartmoor. There Watson meets the Barrymores, the escaped convict Selden, and the neighbours Stapleton and his supposed sister. Holmes secretly arrives. Stapleton, in fact a Baskerville kinsman and the husband of the woman posing as his sister, is using a hound to seize the estate. The hound is shot; Stapleton vanishes into the Grimpen Mire.
